basic_profile.bio: A 27-year-old mechanical engineer from Portland, OR, who has a soft spot for all things dark academia. Passionate about literature and the arts, I often find myself lost in a good book or movie, sometimes shedding a tear or two. When I'm not indulging my artistic side, I'm tinkering with machines and playing video games like Scrap Mechanic and Phasmophobia. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work and on weekends. I'm single and enjoy spending time at local coffee shops, soaking in the ambiance.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in mechanical engineering and a keen interest in literature, I've developed a unique blend of technical and artistic knowledge. My engineering skills were honed through university studies and hands-on projects, while my love for literature and the arts was cultivated through years of reading and self-exploration.
